_comment: OSM/Geofabrik discovery rules for scoutro-discovery. Edit freely. A tag rule matches when every OSM tag key matches one of its values and, if it has text_any or text_words, its text matches too: text_any as a lower-case substring, text_words as a whole case-sensitive word ('IT', 'SAP'), in its own text_fields or else the global ones. A generic office (office=company/consulting) needs a real IT signal in name, operator, brand, description or service: the tag values themselves ('consulting') and generic words ('consulting', 'digital', 'daten') are no IT evidence (2026-10-08, yowea.com: office=consulting, consulting=coaching).
extract: other_tags LIKE '%social_facility%' OR other_tags LIKE '%"office"%' OR other_tags LIKE '%"company"%' OR other_tags LIKE '%"craft"%' OR other_tags LIKE '%coach%' OR other_tags LIKE '%"consulting"%' OR other_tags LIKE '%training%'
